concerns.text: Task T027 defines percolation threshold as 'smallest avg degree where ≥80% connected', but spec FR-017 and SC-003 require 'inflection point analysis... where P(connected) = 0.50'. No task covers the 50% inflection point logic required by the spec.
Task T012 hardcodes Fuchs-Sondheimer lambda=10nm, but spec FR-002 and FR-011 explicitly mandate lambda=40nm. No task exists to implement the correct 40nm parameter.

Task T004 specifies CLI argument '--material-k <value>' for non-standard materials, but spec FR-016 requires '--material-override <name>=<value>'. No task covers the correct argument parsing and name-value mapping.

Task T043 implements dynamic sample size calculation but omits the FR-018 requirement to 'trigger a dynamic adjustment of the simulation grid' (re-scheduling runs) if variance exceeds threshold. The control-flow action is missing.

Task T015 handles CSV output but does not explicitly cover the FR-009 requirement to log 'connectivity_probability' (fraction of connected graphs in batch) and 'convergence_rate' columns, which are distinct from the per-simulation metrics.

Task T027a adds 'percolation_threshold' column to CSV, but spec FR-009 requires logging 'percolation_threshold' as a batch-level metric derived from the inflection point (FR-017), not just a per-simulation value. The batch-level aggregation logic is missing.

Task T045 adds pilot study columns to CSV, but spec SC-006 requires documenting 'whether the final sample size was adjusted'. The task mentions logging columns but does not explicitly cover the decision logic/documentation of the adjustment trigger.
